## Workflows

| Workflow | File | Purpose | Triggers |
|----------|------|---------|----------|
| **CI Pipeline** | [ci.yml](ci.yml) | Lint, test, build, helm validation | Push/PR to main |
| **Security Scanning** | [security.yml](security.yml) | CodeQL, Trivy, Gitleaks, dependency review | Push/PR, weekly, manual |
| **AWS Terraform** | [terraform-aws.yml](terraform-aws.yml) | AWS infrastructure deployment | Push/PR (IaC paths), manual |
| **GCP Terraform** | [terraform-gcp.yml](terraform-gcp.yml) | GCP infrastructure deployment | Push/PR (IaC paths), manual |
| **Release** | [release.yml](release.yml) | Multi-arch builds, SBOM, signing, release | Tag push (v*), manual |
| **Live Status** | [live-status.yml](live-status.yml) | Health monitoring and status page | Every 6 hours, manual |

## Quick Start

1. **Review the documentation:**
   ```bash
   cat .github/workflows/README.md
   ```

2. **Set up secrets** (see QUICK_REFERENCE.md):
   ```bash
   gh secret set AWS_ROLE_ARN_DEV --body "arn:..."
   gh secret set GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_DEV --body "projects/..."
   gh secret set HEALTH_CHECK_URL --body "https://..."
   ```

3. **Create environments:**
   ```bash
   gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/dev -X PUT
   gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/staging -X PUT
   gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/prod -X PUT
   ```

4. **Test a workflow:**
   ```bash
   gh workflow run ci.yml
   gh run watch
   ```

## Workflow States

| Badge | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| Passing | All checks passed |
| Failing | One or more checks failed |
| In Progress | Currently running |
| Cancelled | Manually cancelled |
| Skipped | Conditions not met |

## Common Commands

```bash
# List workflows
gh workflow list

# Run workflow manually
gh workflow run <workflow-name>

# View recent runs
gh run list --workflow=<workflow-name>

# Watch live
gh run watch

# View logs
gh run view --log

# Download artifacts
gh run download <run-id>

# Cancel run
gh run cancel <run-id>

# Re-run failed jobs
gh run rerun <run-id> --failed
```

## Maintenance

### Regular Tasks
- Review security alerts weekly
- Merge Dependabot PRs promptly
- Monitor workflow run times
- Update action versions quarterly
- Review and optimize caching strategy

### Troubleshooting
- Enable debug logging: Set `ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG` secret to `true`
- Check workflow syntax: `yamllint .github/workflows/*.yml`
- Validate locally: Use [act](https://github.com/nektos/act)
- Review logs: `gh run view --log <run-id>`

## Security Notes

All workflows follow security best practices:
- OIDC authentication (no static credentials)
- Minimal permissions per job
- Automated security scanning
- Dependency updates
- Secret scanning
- SBOM generation
- Image signing

For detailed security information, see [README.md](README.md#security-best-practices).
